name: Founder Edition
about: One season pass. starts (season_1 only) is the calendar day the first season begins; every later season begins one season length (months, half a year) after the one before, so season 2 starts 2027-03-29, around Easter. A season runs months (6, half a year) and follows one theme (a theme id from Content/themes/item_themes.json); founderEdition: true tags every reward as founder-edition unless a reward says otherwise. A new season is a new file season_<N>.json plus art. theme, founderEdition and bound (true = tied to the account, not sellable) may also be set per reward. The pass rewards: one free and one premium reward per tier (tiers 1 to 30). kind: badge, theme, namePlate, backdrop, saveSlot, advisorLine, richListFlair, tradePlate (use colors for the look), card (card is an id from Content/cards/cards.json), box (amount = number of boxes) or gold (amount = gold). Order does not matter. Image: <kind>.<id>.png in App/Ledger/Resources/Content/art.
